punchline: Ferriss's example engineer got to Oktoberfest by first asking his boss for just two days at home, on a two-week trial.
thirty_sec: In The 4-Hour Workweek, Ferriss walks through an engineer he calls Sherwood. He gets the company to pay for a course, works two sick days from home and logs three extra designs a day. Then he asks his boss for two remote days for two weeks, cancel any time. Once the numbers look good, it's four days, then full time. He ends up buying a $524 ticket to Munich for Oktoberfest.
